text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein calls for radical reform in the state bureacracy and transforming the Hashimiya palace to an orphanage; monarch and his family to move to a new house called the "gate of peace".
- Engineers stage a sit-in and emphasise they plan a programme of escalation; Prime Minister Abdul-Kabariti Kabariti says their gains will not be touched.
- Deputy Prime Minister Abdullah Ensour says King Hussein will discuss the issues of Jerusalem and an Israeli settlements drive in his coming visit to Washington.
- Jordan to sign an agreement with the EU on a partnership accord within the next few months after differences in view are narrowed.
- Preparations for government reshuffle are simmering.
- Qatari crown prince due in Amman on Wednesday to hold talks with senior Jordanian officials.
- Premier holds talks with Palestinian minister on situation, bilateral ties.
